description: Minimal grants for the main window. App-defined commands (get_app_info, db_health, extract_receipt, export_transactions, create_backup) need no permission. The OCR plugin command, the file-open dialog (for picking a receipt image, FR-2.1), and the file-save dialog (for picking an export or encrypted-backup destination, FR-4.2/FR-4.1, desktop-first) are granted. Remaining fs/biometric grants are added per-feature when the frontend actually calls them (new-feature skill) - keep this list minimal.
